items.q: Quadrats are best suited to estimating the population size of:
items.qAf: Kwadrate is die geskikste om die bevolkingsgrootte te skat van:
options: large mammals in a game reserve
items.explain: Quadrats sample organisms that stay in place long enough to count.
items.explainAf: Kwadrate neem monsters van organismes wat lank genoeg op een plek bly om te tel.

items.q: Ten 1 m² quadrats contain 4, 6, 3, 5, 7, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8 daisies. The field is 500 m². The estimated population is:
items.qAf: Tien kwadrate van 1 m² bevat 4, 6, 3, 5, 7, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8 madeliefies. Die veld is 500 m². Die geskatte bevolking is:

items.q: Why should quadrats be placed randomly?
items.qAf: Waarom moet kwadrate lukraak geplaas word?
options: To avoid bias in choosing where to sample
optionsAf: Om te keer dat die plante vertrap word
Om sydigheid te vermy in die keuse van waar om monsters te neem
Om die meeste organismes te vind
items.explain: Random placement makes the sample representative of the whole area.
items.explainAf: Lukrake plasing maak die monster verteenwoordigend van die hele gebied.

items.q: 40 mice are caught, marked and released. Later 50 are caught, of which 10 are marked. The estimated population is:
items.qAf: 40 muise word gevang, gemerk en vrygelaat. Later word 50 gevang, waarvan 10 gemerk is. Die geskatte bevolking is:

items.q: Which assumption is needed for the capture–mark–recapture method to be valid?
items.qAf: Watter aanname is nodig vir die vang–merk–hervang-metode om geldig te wees?
options: All animals are caught in the first sample
Marked animals stay in one place
The marks do not affect the animals’ survival
optionsAf: Alle diere word in die eerste monster gevang
Gemerkte diere bly op een plek
Die merke beïnvloed nie die diere se oorlewing nie
items.explain: Marks must not make animals easier for predators to see or affect their behaviour.
items.explainAf: Merke moet diere nie makliker vir roofdiere sigbaar maak of hul gedrag beïnvloed nie.

items.q: If some marks wash off before the second sample, the population estimate will be:
items.qAf: As sommige merke afwas voor die tweede monster, sal die bevolkingskatting:
items.explain: Fewer recaptures are counted as marked, so R is too small and N = MC/R is too large.
items.explainAf: Minder hervangste word as gemerk getel, dus is R te klein en N = MC/R te groot.

items.q: A square frame used to sample plants or slow-moving animals.
items.qAf: ’n Vierkantige raam wat gebruik word om plante of stadig bewegende diere te bemonster.

items.q: The method of catching, marking, releasing and catching again to estimate population size.
items.qAf: Die metode om te vang, te merk, vry te laat en weer te vang om bevolkingsgrootte te skat.

items.q: Counting every individual in a population.
items.qAf: Om elke individu in ’n bevolking te tel.

items.q: A line along which samples are taken at regular intervals.
items.qAf: ’n Lyn waarlangs monsters met gereelde tussenposes geneem word.

items.text: Quadrats should be placed [[]] to avoid bias. Using [[]] quadrats makes the estimate more reliable.
items.textAf: Kwadrate moet [[]] geplaas word om sydigheid te voorkom. Om [[]] kwadrate te gebruik, maak die skatting meer betroubaar.

items.q: In mark–recapture, the marks must not make the animals easier for predators to catch.
items.qAf: By merk-hervang moet die merke nie die diere makliker vir roofdiere maak om te vang nie.
items.explain: True. Otherwise marked animals would die more often and the estimate would be wrong.
items.explainAf: Waar. Anders sou gemerkte diere meer dikwels doodgaan en die skatting sou verkeerd wees.

items.q: Quadrats are a good method for counting a population of fast-moving birds.
items.qAf: Kwadrate is ’n goeie metode om ’n bevolking vinnig bewegende voëls te tel.
items.explain: False. Quadrats suit plants and slow animals; mark–recapture suits mobile animals.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Kwadrate pas plante en stadige diere; merk-hervang pas mobiele diere.

items.q: Five 1 m² quadrats contain 4, 6, 3, 5 and 7 daisies. The field is 200 m². Estimate the number of daisies in the field.
items.qAf: Vyf kwadrate van 1 m² bevat 4, 6, 3, 5 en 7 madeliefies. Die veld is 200 m². Skat die aantal madeliefies in die veld.
items.explain: Mean per quadrat = (4 + 6 + 3 + 5 + 7) ÷ 5 = 5 per m². Population = 5 × 200 = 1 000.
items.explainAf: Gemiddeld per kwadraat = (4 + 6 + 3 + 5 + 7) ÷ 5 = 5 per m². Bevolking = 5 × 200 = 1 000.

items.q: In a pond, 60 fish are caught, marked and released. A week later 80 are caught, of which 12 are marked. Estimate the fish population.
items.qAf: In ’n dam word 60 visse gevang, gemerk en vrygelaat. ’n Week later word 80 gevang, waarvan 12 gemerk is. Skat die visbevolking.
